proposal.summary: GitLab projects API pagination can be skipped in specified versions, which may allow an attacker to cause denial of service on some instances.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab all versions starting from 15.2 before 16.1.5; all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5; all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped, potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.

AV.quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped

AC.quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped

A.quote: potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and reproduce the pagination-skip behavior against a test instance, capture request patterns that skip pagination, assess required authentication/privileges, and implement rate-limiting or pagination validation fixes; prepare backport patches for affected versions.
